subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: The Mobile User Context
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Mobile User Context usable.

hook.text: A user fills out a form on the bus. The tunnel kills the signal. The app loses all their input.

buildup.text: Mobile users face interruptions: calls, notifications, low battery, and unstable connections.

discovery.text: Testing must simulate real-world interruptions to verify the app recovers gracefully from each.

twist.text: Desktop users sit at desks with stable connections. Mobile users move through variable environments.

climax.text: After adding interruption tests, the app auto-saves form data. Connectivity drops no longer erase input.

punchline.text: Mobile users don't live in perfect conditions. Test accordingly.

quiz.question: Why must mobile testing simulate interruptions?
options: Users face calls, notifications, and signal loss constantly
